items.corrections: A narrowed machine-learning alloy design study reported composition-and-processing-aware yield-strength prediction and experimentally examined candidates. It does not support the universal first-principles design engine or the time/impact forecasts.

ANSI news describes reported nanoscale self-healing experiments but is secondary coverage. The actual Nature primary paper was inaccessible; no independently read primary result establishes the assigned structural-metal self-repair.

The bounded search found literature focused on fatigue limits and very-high-cycle failures but no inspectable primary result demonstrating infinite life under arbitrary cyclic loading. The universal “any loading” claim and impact forecast remain unsupported by this audit.

A specific BMG experimental article was found but blocked at retrieval. The search receipt indicates a particular alloy and finite casting thickness, but that uninspected snippet is not evidence used here.

Two read abstracts report narrower room-temperature ductility advances: >150% elongation in a processed Al-based alloy and up to 108.7% in bulk Mo. Neither reaches the proposed >1000% low-cost steel/Al capability.

The bounded search did not locate a readable primary result supporting absolute immunity to all corrosion modes across all environments. Corrosion testing standards and isolated resistant materials do not establish the universal claim.
A read experimental study examined two refractory HEAs after 1200°C/10 h oxidation and identified oxide-layer composition and porosity; it also documents substantial oxidation limitations.

A primary study reports industrial-condition directional solidification of specific single-crystal superalloy blades, with microstructure varying by blade location and method. Universal, defect-free, meter-scale growth is unsupported.

A study of household-can aluminum remelting measured alloy quality and found that process settings changed yield, dross, inclusions and Mg content. It does not demonstrate property-preserving infinite recycling.

A specific primary quasicrystal study about small-scale room-temperature ductility was found, but the PMC article page was blocked. No inspectable evidence supports the proposed combination of bulk ductility, >50 GPa hardness, low density and scalable production.

notes: All seven used URLs independently reopened; actual titles/topics/passages match.
ANSI self-healing coverage is secondary, so MET-02 changed from partial-progress to background-only; primary access failure does not disprove the underlying study.
Split all ten formerly single compound claims into specific narrow support, unsupported exact universal/numeric qualifiers where relevant, and unsupported impact forecasts.
Retained author-preprint attribution and studied-alloy/temperature/cycle/scale boundaries; no universal achievements inferred.
Added explicit per-item evidence records including MET-09 s8, and marked ANSI source type secondary news summary.

sourceChecks.excerpt: fatigue cracks in pure metals can undergo intrinsic self-healing
sourceChecks.limitations: Secondary ANSI news summary relying on Reuters and the Nature study; not an inspected primary experimental result.
sourceChecks.paraphrase: ANSI reports that the cited Sandia/Texas A&M study observed spontaneous healing of fatigue cracks in pure platinum and copper during nanoscale experiments, described as crack-flank cold welding.
sourceChecks.title: What Could Self-Healing Metals Mean for the Future of Engineering?

sourceChecks.excerpt: Here we present a framework to predict and optimize the yield strength of face-centered cubic (FCC) HEAs
sourceChecks.limitations: Case study is limited to selected CoCrFeMnNi-based HEAs and yield strength. It does not establish first-principles prediction of arbitrary property combinations or instant universal alloy design. Independent review read reopened source snapshot; no live-availability assertion.
sourceChecks.paraphrase: The preprint reports a model combining composition and processing parameters for FCC high-entropy-alloy yield-strength prediction; it gives R²=0.915 and reports experimentally examined candidate alloys.
sourceChecks.title: Interpretable Machine Learning for High-Strength High-Entropy Alloy Design

sourceChecks.excerpt: After oxidation at 1200°C for 10 hours, a distinct aluminosilicate layer could be observed
sourceChecks.limitations: The results do not show stability above 1600°C, long service life, strength retention, or coating-free performance in turbine/hypersonic conditions. Independent review read reopened source snapshot; no live-availability assertion.
sourceChecks.paraphrase: Two experimental refractory HEAs formed aluminosilicate layers after 1200°C/10 h oxidation; the paper reports those layers were discontinuous and the internal oxidation zones porous.
sourceChecks.title: Microstructural Investigation of Oxidized Complex Refractory High Entropy Alloys

sourceChecks.excerpt: Five blades from the mold for each process were then selected to examine the dendritic microstructure
sourceChecks.limitations: This is a specific alloy and blade process, not meter-scale crystals, arbitrary compositions, zero defects, or improved creep/fatigue life. Independent review read reopened source snapshot; no live-availability assertion.
sourceChecks.paraphrase: The paper experimentally compared industrial-condition directional solidification methods for single-crystal superalloy blades and measured dendritic microstructure differences across blade regions.
sourceChecks.title: Directional Solidification of Single-Crystal Blades in Industrial Conditions Using the Developed Gas Cooling Casting Method

sourceChecks.excerpt: the alloy composition of the remelted metal is dependent on decoating temperature
sourceChecks.limitations: One scrap stream and a small experimental series do not establish unlimited closed-loop cycles, original-property restoration, all engineering alloys, or the stated carbon/mining impacts. Independent review read reopened source snapshot; no live-availability assertion.
sourceChecks.paraphrase: Experimental remelting of household-can aluminum found yield, dross, oxide inclusion content, and alloy composition depended on decoating temperature; higher temperature improved yield/inclusion content but reduced magnesium.
sourceChecks.title: Recycling of Aluminium from Mixed Household Waste

sourceChecks.excerpt: to attain elongations to failure of > 150% while retaining the enhanced strength
sourceChecks.limitations: This database reproduces an abstract rather than the full article. The result is below 1000%, concerns a specific processed Al-based alloy, and does not establish low-cost repeatable superplasticity in ordinary steels or Al alloys. Independent review read reopened source snapshot; no live-availability assertion.
sourceChecks.paraphrase: The indexed abstract reports a 2010 aluminum-based alloy processed by severe plastic deformation with room-temperature elongation above 150%, attributed to grain-boundary wetting/sliding.
sourceChecks.title: Unusual super-ductility at room temperature in an ultrafine-grained aluminum alloy

sourceChecks.excerpt: with a maximum of 108.7% obtained after 1200 °C annealing
sourceChecks.limitations: This result concerns pure Mo, not low-cost ferrous/aluminum alloys, and falls short of the >1000% milestone. Independent review read reopened source snapshot; no live-availability assertion.
sourceChecks.paraphrase: The authors report recrystallized bulk molybdenum samples with room-temperature elongation up to 108.7% after annealing.
sourceChecks.title: Revealing the room temperature superplasticity in bulk recrystallized molybdenum

notes: Controller inspected all ten records, each narrow result, unsupported universal/numeric qualifiers and impact components. Independently reviewed seven matching-source passage receipts; MET09 primary abstract evidence repaired before validation. ANSI secondary coverage is background only; material-specific tests and predictions do not establish universal achievements. Final per-page wording reconciliation: replaced original aspiration/combined multi-source supportedClaim text with the already reviewed narrow passage paraphrase for each individual source. No classification, underlying source, original claim, impact or tree link changed.
